top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a single, simple chemical invention, the reversible 3'-blocked nucleotide with cleavable fluorophore on clustered single molecules, whose consequences are fully realised and independently confirmed over about twenty years; maturity is undisputed and the two-name allocation (Balasubramanian, Klenerman) is the cleanest on the slate, with the citation scoped to the chemistry rather than the platform. P002 follows because it keeps the same core and adds base editing, whose maturity and distinctness from the 2020 prize are less settled. Degrader proposals come next: P005 for the structure-guided ternary-complex design rule, P006 for the clinically mature cereblon arm but with a two-mechanism citation. Condensates (P004) are conceptually strong but the in vivo evidence is still contested, and I prefer any mature award to no award.
